authoringIndependence: This reviewer made no changes to production sources or existing tests.
observations: Normal, start, and import writes remain inside the Web Locks wrapper with full expected-snapshot comparison before writes.
Transitions clone original state. UI replaces current state only after a successful primary save, and mirror-only failure returns an explicit warning.
Invalid import shape and mismatched original payload are rejected before original archive slots or active saves are written.
V1-V4 migration preserves committed identity, route/reward/shop/enemy state and RNG; archive writes keep the readable original chosen by primary-then-mirror recovery.

No additional schema tightening is recommended from this review. Missing event offers/targets after allowed inventory actions remain safe because their choices revalidate current ownership and protection.

Launcher starts only the shipped loopback server, checks current-release HTML identity, and opens a fixed loopback URL. Server whitelists shipping resources, binds 127.0.0.1, and contains no file writes or external network calls.
The inspected package has no runtime dependencies or installation hooks. check.mjs invokes Node syntax checks; simulator and scoped storage/migration tests use local code and fixtures.

reproductions.countCaveat: Closure assertions, fixtures, focused cases, default file-level run, and root's full suite overlap; do not sum them as unique test coverage.

limitations: Legal-state branching fixtures use generated floor-400 rooms with seeded inventories. They are synthetic transaction scenarios, not natural player journeys or measured exploit incidence.
Primary-write failure is injected into in-memory Storage; real browser quota and OS/power-loss behavior were not reproduced by this reviewer.
No independent browser or actual Windows double-click execution was performed by this reviewer.
Synchronous large-save snapshots and browser quota headroom remain an existing measurement risk; this review does not declare their performance improved.
